w: Swamishri answered a couple of questions posed to him during the Bal Shibir. Q: We make a lot of mistakes yet you never show any displeasure towards us. How can our mistakes be avoided and with what thought do you forgive us? A: To err is human. Only God and His holy sadhu never err. But we project our faults in God and His holy sadhu. And to dissolve them they tolerate our errors and faults. God out of compassion loves and talks to us. If God and His holy sadhu start looking at our faults then we would not be able to sit here. To make us stronger they do not look at our faults. This is their compassion, grace, and patience. If one thinks on their lines then one would stop from erring.

Q: What expectations do you have from us? A: It was Yogiji Maharaj's dream that children become virtuous and through them our society and nation too. For this you have to avoid eating outside. Keep away from bad company. To become ideal means to live a pure life, have honesty, morality, the spirit to help others, dharma and bhakti. You should become virtuous so that it pleases God and your parents. Study well and serve God and the country.
During an Interview at the Kishore-Kishore Shibir, Swamishri Gave Succinct and Clear Answer to the Spiritual Inquiries of the Kishores

Q: What do you think during your routine walk? A: Most of the time passes in chanting the Swaminarayan mantra. Sometimes, we think about how to solve a problem written by a devotee. But mostly the walking time passes in chanting the mantra.

Q: When we are with you we feel happy and strong. But why does this not remain when we go away from you? A: Firstly, one has not understood the glory (mahima) as it is. It is because of body-consciousness (dehbhav) that one cannot experience happiness. But if you have 'mahima' then you will be happy in all situations.

Q: We hear in Satsang that God and His holy sadhu are with you. But how can one experience this? A: If you have understood that they are with you, then your focus will be towards their commands (agna), wishes (ruchi) and opinions (abhipraya).
Q: On seeing kishores what thoughts cross your mind? A: On seeing kishores we have only one thought - that you all by the dream of Yogiji Maharaj become firm in Satsang and inspire satsang in others.

Q: What do you think when we disobey your agna? A: Being a human being one is prone to committing mistakes. And God and His holy sadhu do not reject such a person but call him and ask him with affection so that he may improve. Because if he rejects him, and as a consequence leaves Satsang, then the kishore's soul will fall back. So he does not reject him and allows him to correct himself and do 'seva'.

Q: How can we know that you are happy on us? A: In obeying the agnas we are pleased. But we are not pleased at one who does it to show-off and one who harbors jealousy. We are pleased if one talks about the glory (of God and all) and does not have doubtful feelings for God and His holy sadhu.

Q: Even after having such a great attainment (prapti) why is there lack of peace within? A: Gunatitanand Swami has answered that it is due to: 1. 2. This means 'dehbhav' - 'I'ness and 'Mine'ness. If one realizes oneself as atma then no worldly desires remain and one will be able to obey the commands.

Q: Which time of the day is your favorite time? A: The entire day is good. When actions and discourses on His holy sadhu, katha and kirtan are being held then all that time is the best. Therefore one should remember God in all one's actions.

Q: To please you we do 'seva' and 'katha' but we get bored. What should we do? A: In this world which activity is boring? When you were to come here to America were you bored? One doesn't get bored in one's own physical activity because one finds it full of worth. But it is full of misery. And besides why should it be boring when one wants to go to God! One gets bored because one does not have the resolve for the spiritual path like that for one's body. Were Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj ever bored? So many obstacles came their way but they did not fall back. Therefore, we want to go a…a…all (thea …a…a…ath) the way to Akshardham so you should not get bored. Swamishri's unique style of saying 'thea…a…a…ath' (a…a…all) touched the kishores and kishoris and became one of the highlights of the Shibir experience.

The Janmashtami Festival commenced at 8.00pm. The 4-hour program was interlaced with speeches, bhajans and drama. Initally Viveksagar Swami spoke on the divine lila of Shri Krishna. The youths then enacted incidents from the life of Shri Krishna (Krishna Lila). After a bhajan Mahant Swami addressed the assembly and finally Swamishri blessed the congregation. After performing arti at 12 midnight, Swamishri rocked Thakorji in a hindolo amidst the festive bhajans sung by sadhus. More then 5,000 devotees had attended the festival.
A mandir established in a village enhances its opulence. By opulence we mean character.
Despite all his duties a pilot always has his eyes on the compass. Similarly, we too should have one goal - to do that which pleases God, no matter where we go.
By making others happy, you will become happy. By giving joy to others, you will get joy. And by doing good to others, you are doing good to yourself.
If you do good you are a man, and if not, then you have lapsed from humanity.

Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of 32 murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Shri Radha Krishna Dev, Shri Hanumanji, Shri Ganpatiji and Lalji Maharaj to be installed in mandirs in Boston, Columbus, Cherry Hill and Atlantic City, USA. Thereafter, Swamishri blessed the assembly, "Through the wish of Shriji Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj mandirs are being established in India and abroad. By the grace of the murtis of Maharaj, Swami and the deities installed there, there has been an increase in Satsang... These murtis will be transported to America... Let us pray to God to bless everyone there with righteousness and good feelings and understanding of the glory of Maharaj and Swami... These murtis will redeem everyone and inspire peace, happiness and morality in all..."

In the morning, over 4,000 devotees gathered for the Rakshabandhan festival. Swamishri blessed the assembly, "We have the shelter of Maharaj and have attained Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. They will protect us physically and spiritually. Spiritually they protect from lust, anger and other base instincts and desires... By observing their commands and offering devotion one attains peace in this world and the next. By offering devotion to God protection is attained. This becomes our last birth. One becomes brahmarup, free of all desires and ekantik."

At 5.20 p.m. Swamishri left for Bharuch, arriving there at 7.20 p.m. In the evening welcome assembly, the Rakshabandhan festival was celebrated. Swamishri said in his blessings, "Our true protection is provided by God. Protection by others removes bodily and financial difficulties but God and His holy Sadhu protect us by freeing us from the cycle of births and deaths."
